limitations: Only three query families are evaluated.
Labels inherit Wikimedia search-category bias and are not blind human judgments.
Nine synthetic derivative/duplicate candidates are unjudged and count as non-relevant.
This pilot is directional integration evidence, not a general multilingual retrieval claim.

providers.legacy_image_vectors: reused raw-v2 image vectors because the legacy subclass only changes text preparation

scope.labels: Wikimedia download search terms; not independent human relevance judgments
scope.ranking_contract: production score rounded to 6 decimals, then quality descending, then stable photo UUID
